items.name: licenses
items.title: Licenses
items.description: RemixCN's MIT license and the full license texts of shadcn/ui, Base UI and Remix. Every RemixCN item installs them.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Headings with native buttons that open and close their panels, one at a time or several, with disabled items and a cancelable change event.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A callout with an optional icon, title, description and action, whose live role follows the message's urgency.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A modal native dialog with the alertdialog role that waits for an answer: a cancel and a confirming action, no dismissal by outside presses, and Escape to cancel.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Keeps its content at a width-to-height ratio with the native aspect-ratio property.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: A file or image with its name, details, upload state and actions, local previews that release their object URLs, a full-card trigger, and scrolling groups.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: An image with a fallback while it loads or when it fails, plus a corner badge, groups and a count.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small label in six variants, and badgeVariants() for links that look like badges.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A navigation landmark with an ordered list of native links, separators, the current page and an ellipsis.

items.name: bubble
items.title: Bubble
items.description: A message surface in seven looks that sizes to its text, aligns to either side, groups, and carries reactions, with bubbleContentVariants() for links and buttons.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A native button in six variants and eight sizes, and buttonVariants() for links that look like buttons.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Joins buttons, inputs, text and separators into one control, in a row or a column.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid to pick a day, several days or a range, as YYYY-MM-DD civil dates, with Intl locales, week numbers, month and year dropdowns, keyboard navigation and form values.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A surface with a header, title, description, action, content and footer, in two sizes.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Slides in a native scroll container with snap points: previous and next buttons, arrow keys, mouse drags, optional autoplay with a toggle, and an API.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A native checkbox in shadcn's style, with a mixed state for partial selections.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: Code, terminal output and diffs as escaped text, with a header, line numbers, line variants, your own highlighter's tokens and a copy button.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A native button that shows and hides a panel, open by default or controlled, with transitions that reduced motion turns off.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A command menu: a search field over grouped commands, filtered and sorted as you type, with keyboard and pointer selection, shortcuts as text, and a command dialog.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A native dialog over a dimmed page, modal or not, controlled or not, with triggers, close buttons, a title, a description, a header and a footer.

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: Sets the text direction of a subtree with the native dir attribute, and reads it while rendering or in the browser.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A native dialog on any edge of the screen that follows mouse, touch and pen drags: swipe it closed or between snap points, with buttons that do the same from the keyboard.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: Shows that there is nothing here yet, with media, a title, a description and actions.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Native fieldsets, legends, labels, descriptions, separators and error alerts that lay out a form control in three orientations.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: Previews what's behind a link while the pointer rests on it or it has keyboard focus. The card can be hovered, and touch follows the link.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A native input for text, email, numbers, dates, times, files and colors, with literal ARIA states.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: One box around a native input or textarea with addons, text and buttons, which draws its focus ring and invalid state.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: A one-time code in one native text input, drawn as slots, groups and separators, with pattern filtering, paste and masking.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A row with media, a title, a description and actions, in groups that are lists, and itemVariants() for links.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Native kbd elements for single keys and key combinations.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: A native label that names its control and dims with a disabled one.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: A status line, note or labelled divider in a conversation, with a decorative icon and markerVariants() for links and buttons.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: A conversation row with an avatar, a header, the message and a footer, aligned to either side, and groups of rows.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: A chat transcript in a native scroll container that opens at the end or the last turn, follows replies while you stay at the end, starts new turns near the top, keeps your place when content changes, and jumps to any message.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: A native select with a chevron, two sizes, option groups, and default or controlled values in the server HTML.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Native page links with the current page, Previous and Next, an ellipsis, and turned-off boundary links. No JavaScript needed.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A dialog beside its trigger in a native popover: placement, collision avoidance, focus in and back, Escape and outside presses, nesting and a modal mode. Without JavaScript the browser opens it.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A progress bar with a label and a formatted value, determinate or indeterminate.

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: One question at a time in a native form: radios, checkboxes and a freeform answer, with progress, checks, keys, and a snapshot of every answer on submit.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A group of native radios with one name, so the browser moves the selection with the arrow keys.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Panel groups that resize with the pointer and the keyboard: rows, columns and nested groups, minimum, maximum and default sizes, collapsible panels, and layout events.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A native scroll container with thin scrollbars that follow it. The system's scrollbars stay without JavaScript and in forced colors.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A button that opens a list of items over or beside it, with groups, keys, typing, single and multiple values, and a native select that holds the form value and works without JavaScript.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A horizontal or vertical line, meaningful or decorative.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A Dialog that slides in from the top, right, bottom or left edge of the screen.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A placeholder shape that pulses while content loads, hidden from assistive technology.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: One or more native range-input thumbs on a shared track: horizontal or vertical, right-to-left, keyboard and pointer, one form value per thumb.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner
items.description: Sonner's Toaster and toast() names on top of Toast, without the sonner package: typed toasts, actions, promises and several Toasters.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A turning ring with a status name, or decorative next to text that says what is pending.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A native checkbox with the switch role, drawn as a track and a thumb in two sizes.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: A tab list with one tab stop and arrow-key navigation, manual or automatic activation, default and line variants, in rows or columns.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A native textarea that grows with its text where the browser supports it.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Toasts in a stack that pauses on hover and focus: a Toaster, the toast manager, and the provider, viewport and parts to build your own.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A native button that turns on and off, with a literal aria-pressed, in two variants and three sizes.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Toggles with one value in single or multiple mode, as one tab stop with arrow-key focus, horizontal or vertical.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short description of its trigger on hover and keyboard focus, with an arrow, shared delays and Escape. The trigger is described before any script runs.

items.name: trace
items.title: Trace
items.description: Lines for the steps an agent takes, with running, failed and pending states, rows that expand on Collapsible, link and dialog rows, and an option that announces changes of status.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: Pickers built from Popover and Calendar: a day, a range, a date of birth, a typed YYYY-MM-DD field and a time, with locale labels and form values.

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: Styles for headings, paragraphs, quotes, lists, inline code, links and tables, as mixins for native elements.

items.name: anchor-position
items.title: Anchor positioning
items.description: Places a popup beside an element or a point, flips and shifts it to stay in view, and keeps it there while the page scrolls and resizes.

items.name: aria
items.title: ARIA states
items.description: Writes boolean aria-* props as "true" or "false", the strings ARIA reads, also in server HTML.

items.name: civil-date
items.title: Civil dates
items.description: YYYY-MM-DD days counted in the Gregorian calendar without Date parsing or host time zones: arithmetic, week numbers, week starts, today in a time zone and Intl formatting.

items.name: composite
items.title: Composite navigation
items.description: Keyboard navigation for toolbars, menus, tabs and lists: roving focus or active descendant, with orientation, right-to-left text, Home and End, typeahead, key aliases, and disabled, hidden and nested items, and a typeahead buffer for widgets that match items themselves.

items.name: focus-scope
items.title: Focus scope
items.description: Initial and return focus for popups, with a fallback when the trigger was removed or disabled.

items.name: hover-intent
items.title: Hover intent
items.description: Opens a popup while the pointer rests on its trigger or it has keyboard focus, with delays, a safe path to the popup and no opening on touch.

items.name: icons
items.title: Icons
items.description: The Icon wrapper for inline SVG on a 24 by 24 grid, and the icons RemixCN draws itself.

items.name: layer
items.title: Dismissable layer
items.description: A stack of open popups: Escape and outside presses dismiss the topmost layer, with nested and parallel layers.

items.name: modal
items.title: Modal inertness and scroll lock
items.description: Stops page scrolling and makes everything outside a modal popup inert, and restores both when it closes.

items.name: styles
items.title: Style conventions
items.description: Style objects for css(): focus ring, invalid and disabled states, hidden text, transitions, a text shimmer, right-to-left mirroring and button group joins.

items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: The cascade layer order, shadcn's Neutral colors as light and dark tokens, the type, space, radius, shadow and motion tokens, and a small reset.
